story: Sophie is in the playroom. Sophie has a big red crown. Sophie puts the crown on her head. [emotion:QT/happy] Sophie wants to be a princess! Mia is there too. Mia wants to wear the crown. But the crown is too big for Mia. It falls on the floor. [emotion:QT/sad] Sophie picks up the crown. Sophie and Mia find three ribbons in the box. They tie the ribbons on the crown together. [emotion:QT/surprised] Now the crown fits Mia! Sophie and Mia are both wearing ribbons. [emotion:QT/happy] Sophie and Mia are happy.
